race.comment: SIMPLY SASSY (6) returns after a spell of three months. Started the last campaign impressively when in the placings over 1000m at Ballarat. Hasn't scored when fresh from a break but generally races well with three minor placings and this looks a highly suitable option. THINK I'M DIVINE (3) has been racing in great heart including a last start second over 1100m at Sale, when nabbed late by a 100/1 shot. Backing up looks a good sign. ELLY DEE (7) finished out of the money when fresh from a spell two starts back then was beaten 2.5 lengths when sixth in a 1100m contest at Sale a week ago. Well placed and there is no reason she cannot find winning ways. I'M DYNAMITE (4) finished out of the money two starts back then he got a long way back and was beaten 4.5 lengths when ninth over 1400m at Sale a week ago. This is more suitable. MORDIALLOC BEACH (5) did little first-up, but it was a stronger race than this and she draws to improve sharply.
